function.name: add_todo
function.description: Adds a new todo item to the todo.csv file with auto-generated ID, timestamp, and pending status.

todo_text.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

path.description: The file path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, the default path will be used.

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Delete a todo item from the CSV file by its ID. Returns True if successful, False otherwise.

todo_id.description: The ID of the todo item to be deleted.

path.description: The path to the CSV file. If not provided, default path 'todo.csv' will be used.

function.name: calculate_expression
function.description: Safely evaluates a simple arithmetic expression in string form. Supports +, -, *, /, %, **, parentheses, floats, and scientific notation. Returns the result if valid, otherwise returns False for invalid or malformed input.

path.description: Optional path parameter (not used in calculation).

function.name: factorial
function.description: Calculates the factorial of a non-negative integer. Returns the factorial result, or False for invalid inputs (negative or non-integer).

n.description: The non-negative integer for which to calculate the factorial.

function.name: calculate_factorial_expression
function.description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression containing factorials denoted by '!' along with standard operators (+, -, *, /, %, **) and parentheses. Raises: TypeError if the input is not a string; ValueError for empty or invalid/malformed expressions; ZeroDivisionError for division by zero.

expression.description: The arithmetic expression containing factorial operations '!' and standard operators to be evaluated.
